result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear data/rendering bug ('€NaN delivery') plus a few minor visual concerns around truncation and cut-off carousel items.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section displays '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed numeric calculation or missing delivery fee value being formatted as a number.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined delivery fee values in the formatting logic; show 'Free delivery', a placeholder like '—', or hide the line entirely when the fee is unavailable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the screen edge with no ellipsis styling, making it look abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis within the card bounds, or add peek/padding so partially visible carousel items look intentional.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge showing only a sliver of the pill, which can look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so the next chip peeks in more clearly (e.g., ~30–50% visible) or add a fade/gradient at the edge to signal horizontal scrollability.
